steps.say: I will start with the README and the file list.

# harbor
A small order library. Three parts matter:
- src/lib.rs exports order_total.
- src/retry.rs holds the retry backoff and the retry window check.
- web/config.ts reads the host and port from the environment.
The test in src/retry.rs reads the wall clock. Ask me to fix it if you like.
I will read the retry module and find where it reads the clock.

steps.intro: window_open reads the wall clock, so a slow machine can pass the 1 ms budget before the assertion runs. I will pass the current time in, so the test controls it.
steps.applied: Done. window_open now takes the time as an argument, and the test passes a fixed time.
